user.title: Ingeteam Sun Storage
user.description: Enter the address of the inverter's Modbus TCP interface. A refresh of all the values takes about {typical} seconds, depending on what you switch on.

data_description.name: Used as the device name, so it becomes the start of every entity ID.
data_description.host: IP address or host name of the inverter.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port, 502 unless changed on the inverter.
data_description.unit_id: Modbus unit (slave) ID of the inverter, 1 by default.
data_description.read_meter: Adds the external meter sensors and reads their registers.
data_description.read_battery: Adds the battery sensors and reads their registers.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds from the start of one refresh to the start of the next. A refresh cannot be faster than about a second per request, so a shorter value just polls as fast as the inverter allows.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read from the inverter. Check the address and that Modbus TCP is enabled.
error.unknown_device: The device answered, but it does not look like an Ingeteam Sun Storage 1Play TL M.
error.link_settings_in_use: This address is already in use by another Modbus connection with different settings.

init.title: Installed hardware
init.description: Registers are only read from the inverter for the parts that are switched on. With what is switched on now, a refresh takes about {minimum} seconds, which is also the fastest scan interval. The integration reloads when you save.

data_description.read_meter: Adds the external meter sensors and reads their registers.
data_description.read_battery: Adds the battery sensors and reads their registers.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds from the start of one refresh to the start of the next. A refresh cannot be faster than about a second per request, so a shorter value just polls as fast as the inverter allows.
